scope: Read-only isolated execution of current repository source; no repository edits or commits

pluginRegistry.method: TypeScript transpile of actual pluginRegistry.tsx into a VM; injected React state/effect scheduler and storage adapter
pluginRegistry.limit: Isolated contract reproduction, not real React GUI or physical IndexedDB integration

inventory.method: TypeScript AST and local production source scan excluding test files

existingTests: Test source inspected and presence inventoried; this subagent did not run existing Vitest suites
